what: CRT terminal loader — status and log lines turn on at .16s intervals and the command is typed letter by letter at 40~90ms (the screen flickers at brightness 1.35 for 90ms with each letter), then the cursor blinks with a .69s step-end while waiting for ENTER (the prompt button pulses at 1.38s). On press or Enter · Space the screen flashes at brightness 3.2 and collapses in .1s with cubic-bezier(.7,0,.84,0) to .004x vertical and .94x horizontal, the whole panel disappears over .2s after .12s, then fx:booted fires · with look: beam, instead of collapsing, the lines turn on at .13s intervals while a progress bar fills (the last line waits until the font has loaded) and the prompt text changes to ‹press any key› blinking at 1.2s steps(2), then on press (after .35s past ready) a 3px light line moves from top to bottom in 8 steps at 30fps, erasing the screen it has passed with a clip (.27s) · with type, each line is typed letter by letter at that interval in seconds (minimum .08s per line) and a .55ch bar cursor follows at the end, a blink word inside a line blinks five times at .1s after it is fully typed and the next line starts .06s later — with look: fade, it sits as pale text on a background-colored panel, and on press the screen fades in .35s power2.out and the panel disappears over .5s after .25s (Studio BIOS)

options.each: Interval between lines lighting up (s), default .16
options.dur: Fold-away duration (s), default .1 — use 0 for screens that are flipped often
options.auto: Seconds until it turns off by itself once ready, default 0 (waits until pressed)
options.[data-fx-part=cmd]: (If present) Command to type out — if data-key exists, it types that text
options.[data-fx-part=go]: (If present) Hint button that pulses when ready
options.look: With beam, instead of folding, a light line descends from top to bottom in 8 steps (30fps) and wipes the screen · with fade, no flash or folding, the screen fades over dur (.35) power2.out, and the panel disappears in .5s after a .25s wait (background --kf-bg, text 50% ink)
options.keys: any turns it on with any key (except Shift, Tab, Esc), not just Enter and Space
options.guard: Time (seconds) to drop the press after ready, default 0 · beam is .35
options.skip: when on, pressing before ready switches on all remaining lines at once and skips to ready, default off · beam is on
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: (if present) progress bar whose width fills by the number of lit lines — the last line comes after document.fonts.ready (max 3.5s)
options.[data-fx-part=go] data-ready: Replace the notice text with this once ready
options.type: Gap in seconds between typed characters per line. If given, every line is typed out (min .08s per line, default .06s between lines). One reference site uses .012
options.[data-fx-part=blink]: (when type) status word (skip·OK) that blinks five times at .1s after the line is fully typed

use:
BRAND OS 00.00 · TTY1

READY.
note: Color defaults to the stage’s opposite colors (--kf-contrast-bg·ink) — a phosphor-green terminal look is made by the user overriding color. It is a full-screen loader, so when it finishes, receive fx:booted and remove the element
